name: smwgraphics-virtua-racing-deluxe-highland
title: Virtua Racing Deluxe - Highland
description:
Ripped from Highland in Virtua Racing Deluxe on Sega 32x.

Caution: uses 5 exgfx slots!

Note: This background has been used only with the Layer 2 Editing Mode, because it can't be completed by trying to put it with the Background Layer 2 Editor. Meant to be used with a Layer 2 level.

Update: Some 8x8 tiles has been modified to make sure it's really like in the original game.
